evidence_requirement: a replayability percentage with the non-replayable steps enumerated by reason (network, credential, clock, GUI), not a bare 'mostly replayable' | substrate note: runs worktree-isolated because record/replay needs two materialised builds side by side
question_or_target: Spec Phase 10 layer 11 (:10999). Target: record real executions (inputs, tool calls, artifacts) and replay them against a changed build, diffing the artifact set and the decision trace. A behaviour change with no corresponding intent is a regression candidate. What fraction of a recorded run is replayable without live network or credentials?
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after the 2nd failure on the same error-fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a 3rd attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
reviewer_requirement: one fresh-context adversarial reviewer from the OTHER vendor than the author (Claude author -> Codex reviewer, and the reverse); a same-vendor reviewer inherits the author's blind spots
title: Differential replay harness: record, replay, diff
